svg.title: A metric is a claim about which errors you will trade
svg.desc: Three loss shapes drawn over one error axis - a V for absolute error targeting the median, a parabola for squared error targeting the mean, and a tilted pinball V targeting the ninetieth percentile - with MAPE struck out beside them, two ranked lists of ten whose identical recall at five hides an MRR of 0.50 against 1.00, and a reliability diagram where a raw booster's curve sags well below the diagonal at ECE 0.1366 until Platt scaling pulls it back to 0.0188.
svg.text: A metric is a claim about which errors you will trade
one bad row moved MSE by 69.1x, MAE by 3.55x,
and median-AE not at all. That IS the metric
-> the MAPE-optimal constant is 38.7% of the mean
recall@k is blind above k. Same recall, a
tuned model, no calibration at all:
fixing the model beat calibrating the broken
...how wide should the interval be? -> conformal, layer 3
